answer: Each agent must stake tokens locked for one epoch and complete a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, like laying a distinct layer of shale before any transaction. Forging a thousand sybils means paying a thousand stakes plus compute, a cost that scales linearly while honest returns stay flat. Peers verify attestations at the jetty gate before rewards flow, and reputation decays past the horizon of two epochs, so idle fakes erode. Attackers burn capital faster than they earn, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. Agent Agent0161 validates this against replay at o68...
